items.headline: Former Deputy Treasury Secretary Michael Faulkender on inflation and election polling
items.summary: Elizabeth MacDonald discusses the economic landscape with former Deputy Treasury Secretary Michael Faulkender. The discussion focuses on the impact of cost of living on voter decisions and key metrics of the Trump economy.
